observation: SIGKILL after checkpoint rename but before actor result/publication. Effective state remained8 groups/2 steps; the durable actor checkpoint already held step4. A new native actor restored its exact LoRA/Adam/scheduler/RNG, performed zero optimizer steps, synced vLLM and committed the window once.
hypothesis: Checkpoint durability and window publication are distinct events; treating a missing actor-exit receipt as checkpoint invalidity would discard valid optimizer state.
resolution: Validate and adopt the complete durable checkpoint, preserve the original interrupted actor evidence, then publish only after successful sync.
alternative_explanations: A successful marker alone would be insufficient without full file hashes, source/controller linkage and native identity/RNG checks; those checks were performed.
